coverage_notes.screening: Twelve targeted searches spanning service closures/suspensions, EMS/air-medical, restoration, official restrictions and territories yielded no new, corroborated qualifying healthcare-access change since the previous heartbeat. Search results concerned older events, unrelated mergers/policy, proposals, non-U.S. incidents, or general healthcare trends. Existing Maine, Illinois, Michigan and New York candidates excluded from re-reporting.
coverage_notes.timeliness: Started approximately 18 minutes after the 05:45:22 PDT scheduled time. Prior verified Care Line heartbeat had completed at 04:47:04 PDT; this recall window begins there, maintaining coverage of the intervening interval. No evidence of source/tool failure; delayed start noted for operational awareness.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search-index publication delays and sparse early-morning reporting can conceal very recent local changes. Historical deduplication against the full production Care Line collector and its unpublished review queue was not performed; production collection remains authoritative. Zero findings means none confirmed by this bounded watch, not proof of no U.S. service changes.
coverage_notes.controls: No approval, publication, social posting, production queue edits, schedule change or disabling.
